name: agent-counter
prompt: Build a counter app. GET / shows an HTML page with the current count and a button that increments it without reloading. GET /api/count returns JSON {"count": N}. POST /api/increment adds one and returns {"count": N+1}. The count must survive restarts.

name: agent-todo
prompt: Build a to-do list app. GET / shows an HTML page listing todos with a form to add one and a delete button. GET /api/todos returns a JSON array of {"id","text"} oldest first. POST /api/todos with {"text": "..."} creates one and returns it with status 201. DELETE /api/todos/{id} removes it and returns 200.

name: agent-guestbook
prompt: Build a guestbook. GET / shows an HTML page with a form (name, message) and the entries, newest first, with HTML escaped so a message like x is shown as text. POST /api/entries with {"name","message"} stores one and returns it with status 201. GET /api/entries returns a JSON array newest first.

name: agent-shortener
prompt: Build a URL shortener. POST /api/links with {"url": "https://..."} returns 201 and {"code": "abc123"} (a short unique code). GET /r/{code} responds 302 with a Location header set to the URL. GET /api/links returns a JSON array of {"code","url","hits"} where hits counts redirects. GET / shows a simple page with a form.

name: agent-poll
prompt: Build a polling app. POST /api/polls with {"question": "...", "options": ["a","b"]} returns 201 and {"id": N}. POST /api/polls/{id}/vote with {"option": 0} records a vote and returns 200. GET /api/polls/{id} returns {"question", "options": [{"text","votes"}]}. GET / shows an HTML page explaining the API.

name: agent-notes
prompt: Build a notes app with search. POST /api/notes with {"title","body"} returns 201 and the note with an id. GET /api/notes returns all notes as a JSON array, newest first. GET /api/notes?q=word returns only notes whose title or body contains the word, case-insensitive. GET / shows an HTML page with a form and a search box.

name: agent-kv
prompt: Build a small key-value store. PUT /api/kv/{key} with a JSON body stores the value and returns 200. GET /api/kv/{key} returns the stored JSON, or 404 with {"error":"not found"} if missing. DELETE /api/kv/{key} removes it and returns 200. GET /api/kv returns a JSON array of keys, sorted. GET / shows an HTML page describing it.

name: agent-visits
prompt: Build a visit logger. Every GET / records a visit (time and user-agent) and returns an HTML page showing the total visit count. GET /api/visits returns {"total": N, "recent": [last 10 visits, newest first, each with "user_agent" and "at"]}. Requests to /api/visits must not count as visits.

name: agent-expenses
prompt: Build an expense tracker. POST /api/expenses with {"amount": 12.5, "category": "food", "note": "lunch"} returns 201. GET /api/expenses returns a JSON array newest first. GET /api/summary returns {"total": N, "by_category": {"food": N, ...}} with amounts summed. GET / shows an HTML page with a form and the summary.

name: agent-fetcher
prompt: Build an app that checks a website. GET /api/probe fetches https://example.com/ from inside the app (outbound HTTPS, so the app needs a fetch grant for example.com) and returns JSON {"status": 200, "bytes": N} where N is the response body length. GET / shows an HTML page with a button that calls it.
